name: log_bottle
description: Log a bottle feeding in PoopJob. volume_ml is the amount drunk in milliliters and contents is breast_milk or formula. occurred_at is optional and defaults to now.

volume_ml.description: Required. The amount in milliliters, an integer from 1 to 500.

occurred_at.description: Optional. When the feeding happened, as ISO 8601, for example "2026-01-12T08:30:00+02:00". A value without an offset is read in the configured timezone. Defaults to now.
